effects.name: Ice Nova: frost ring
effects.skill: Ice Nova (Frostbind: the same ring at the target)
effects.today: 20 pale smoke puffs within 1 m; the 5 m radius is invisible
effects.look: A flat ring of pale-blue frost motes shoots out from the mage's feet to the 5 m edge in a third of a second and fades there, over a low mist that spreads more slowly.

simple.why: One spawner of 24: fewer bytes and much less server time, but a spawner fills the ring into a disc that is denser at the edge, and no mist.

effects.art: Snowflake sprite (VoxeLibre weather_pack_snow_snowflake1/2, 5×5, CC BY-SA 3.0 TeddyDesTodes) for the ring; draconis ice motes (3×3, MIT) as glitter.
effects.note: The ring is 48 single particles placed by Lua on an exact circle, all at the same speed: about the bytes of one spawner, which could only make a disc.

effects.name: Skill arrow trail
effects.skill: Loose, Snare Shot, Pinning Shot (and Twin Shot)
effects.hook: grug_projectiles spawn_one after add_entity (opt-in per skill)
effects.look: A thin trail of motes behind the arrow, tinted per skill (Loose pale, Snare Shot green, Pinning Shot teal); the motes drift a little and fade within 0.4 s.

simple.why: Twelve motes along the same line.

effects.note: Arrows fly 40-55 m/s, so the trail's spawner lives about half a second. Built as an unattached spawner along the launch line (time = flight time, at most 1 s), so only nearby players receive it. A spawner attached to the arrow follows a curving flight exactly but goes to every player on the server.
